comment: Inputs of the R1-BX-D14 recompute (g4_lib.py dates) for the G.5 table as the G.5 draft defines it (12 instances x W = 20; audits of the evaluated non-inert, non-duplicate proposals and their parents). Before G.4 runs, the *_fallback values stand in for the pilot medians; after it, pilot nodes use their measured H200 seconds and shares and the other nodes the census run time x the measured H200/census ratio. K = 10 binds until the K-check row exists (k_check_passed). Slots, queue, prerequisite and analysis spans are assumptions to confirm. The B7->D3->manuscript spans are the R1-BX-D14 target spans (8 Dec -> 3 Jan -> 10 Jan).
